seo.meta_description: Full Shake Shack menu with prices and calories for 2026: the ShackBurger, SmokeShack, Chick'n Shack, crinkle-cut fries, shakes and concretes.

price_disclaimer: Prices and calories are approximate, are provided as a guide only, and may vary by location. Manhattan, San Francisco and Hawaii run about 20% higher. Last updated October 2026.
intro: Shake Shack is the modern burger chain that grew out of a New York City hot dog cart, known for its griddled ShackBurger made with 100% Angus beef and ShackSauce, crinkle-cut fries, the crispy Chick'n Shack, and frozen custard shakes and concretes. It sits at the premium end of fast food, with a menu that feels more like a roadside stand than a chain. Below is the full Shake Shack menu with prices and calories for 2026.
quick_answer: A single ShackBurger is about $7.69 and a double is $11.49. The SmokeShack is $9.69, the Chick'n Shack is $8.29, and crinkle-cut fries are $4.49. A hand-spun shake is $6.39 and a concrete is about $6.99. The ShackBurger and the shakes are the signatures. A single ShackBurger is about 530 calories.
hot_deal: Shake Shack value: it sits at the premium end, so the best value is the single ShackBurger ($7.69) over the double, and skipping the combo (Shake Shack has no set meal deals). The app and Shack Perks drop occasional free-fries and free-shake offers. Prices run about 20% higher in Manhattan, San Francisco and Hawaii. Prices vary by location.

make_at_home.title: Make Shake Shack at Home
make_at_home.intro: Want a griddled ShackBurger and crinkle fries at home? These picks help.

faqs.a: A single ShackBurger is about $7.69 and a double is $11.49. It is Shake Shack's signature: a griddled Angus patty with American cheese, lettuce, tomato and ShackSauce on a potato bun. A single is about 530 calories.

faqs.q: What is a concrete at Shake Shack?
faqs.a: A concrete is frozen custard blended at high speed with mix-ins until thick, like a Shack version of a Blizzard. The Shack Attack (chocolate everything) is the most famous, about $6.99, and you can build a custom one too.

faqs.q: Why is Shake Shack more expensive?
faqs.a: Shake Shack uses 100% Angus beef with no hormones or antibiotics, fresh produce and frozen custard made in-house, and positions itself as premium fast food. That is why a single ShackBurger runs higher than a classic drive-thru burger.

faqs.q: How many calories are in a ShackBurger?
faqs.a: A single ShackBurger is about 530 calories, a double about 770, and the SmokeShack about 610. Crinkle-cut fries add about 470, and a vanilla shake is around 740, so a full meal adds up quickly.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Shake Shack?
faqs.a: The best known are the ShackBurger, the SmokeShack, the Chick'n Shack, the crinkle-cut fries, and the hand-spun shakes and concretes.
